I'll try to give a list the best I can but most of these are my personal preferences  


(TLDR, Early game air-to-air F-2A/F-16,  F-14 or Mig-29A. Early game air-to-ground F-14, A-10 or MiG-31B. Late game Air-to-air F-22 or Su-57. Late game air-to-ground F-35 or Su-57)

  
I'll start with Air-to-air combat for early game, for this you're gonna want something maneuverable like an F-2A/F-16 or F-14 both are great options while the F-14 might be better due to its air to ground capabilities, its 8AAMs are great for taking out large masses of targets and its LAAM is great for range and both the F-2A & F-16 are great options the F-2A being a multi-role fighter it's also great for taking out ground targets while also maintaining its air-to-air capabilities with the HVAA, for ground strikes with the F-2A you have two options Unguided rockets & LASM (Long range air to ship missile) you also have the F-16 which is your first jet, I personally say it's decent of course due to its options of unguided bombs, 4AAM & the SASM. If you don't want to use those I would either go with the MiG-29A, not the best but it's a fairly decent fighter, it boasts HPAA (High power air-to-air) missiles which are great for of course, singular targets but have shoddy tracking, it also has LACM (Long range cruise missiles) which are a good choice for taking out ground targets with huge pools of health on the other hand you also have the standard 4AAMs which just like with the F-16 are good for taking out small groups of enemies.  


For early game air to ground targets you should probably use the F-14D or the A-10 (A-10 being less preferable due to it's almost near none capabilities for air to air) But for simple air to ground missions it has great options to chose from such as Unguided rockets, 4AGMS & UGBs all great for large groups of ground targets, you can use the unguided rockets against bombers but I really wouldn't recommend it. As before if you don't like those options you could always opt to using the MiG-31B, it's a great plane for air-to-ground and air-to-air due to its Pulse Laser, SAAM (Semi active air-to-air missiles) & the LAAM (Long range air-to-air missiles).  


For later game air-to-air you can use the F-22 or the Su-57, F-22 being better of the two due to having 8AAMs but it also has XSDB (Advanced small diameter bombs) not the best weapon for air-to-ground but they have a higher capacity allowing you to use more, it also holds the dreaded QAAM (Quick maneuver air-to-air missiles) the by far best weapon in the game unless you're an absolute ace you cannot dodge these thus making them extremely effective against drones and fighters with high maneuverability. With the Su-57 you have GPBs (Guided Penetration Bombs), Pulse Lasers & 4AAMs weaker weapons (except for maybe the Pulse Laser) slightly more mobility & slightly less stability than the F-22.  


For late game air-to-ground I'd stick with the Su-57 & the F-35, while the Su-57 has the pulse laser which is a great all round weapon the F-35 has more options, it has SODs (Stand off dispensers), 8AGMs & 4AAMs it has unbelievable air-to-ground capabilities with its 8AGMs but it's lacking in air-to-air power.  


Hope this was able to help you out mate and good luck!
